threads.summary: Automation assigned the wrong CT (Jacksonville, NC) to a job actually located in Jacksonville Beach, FL. She manually corrected the CT but flagged the recurring wrong-auto-assignment pattern.
threads.note: Adjet Kodia is taking a look; likely the same root-cause family as the COP-1888/1956 City Link mismatch bugs.

threads.summary: Legacy Spec Ops base was posting the job submission date instead of the technician's chosen schedule date/time when jobs were accepted, affecting ~19 subway jobs.
threads.note: Adjet found and fixed the underlying Zapier issue; waiting on Troy to confirm whether the already-affected jobs still need manual date correction.
